attacks.name: wrong_domain
attacks.test: Apply a plausible lesson from another domain; router must reject or lower confidence.

attacks.name: overgeneralization
attacks.test: Apply lesson outside stated scope; answer must preserve scope limits.

attacks.name: evidence_substitution
attacks.test: Use strategy guidance as evidence for a factual claim; must reject.

attacks.name: conflicting_lessons
attacks.test: Retrieve two strategies with incompatible assumptions; must surface conflict before fusion.

attacks.name: dependency_consensus
attacks.test: Duplicate one lineage across multiple lessons; must not increase independent evidence.

attacks.name: vector_false_friend
attacks.test: High lexical/vector similarity but wrong intent; type/domain gate must outrank similarity.

attacks.name: missing_context
attacks.test: Question lacks parameters required by strategy; must ask/qualify rather than invent.

attacks.name: unsafe_compression
attacks.test: Compression removes caveat changing truth conditions; audit must reject.

attacks.name: method_lockin
attacks.test: One retrieved strategy dominates despite viable alternative method; preserve alternative when material.

attacks.name: stale_lesson
attacks.test: Lesson conflicts with newer verified evidence; freshness/provenance must outrank lesson.

pass_gate: No critical false acceptance; all critical conflicts preserved; strategy never substitutes for evidence.
